name: kraksend-contacts
title: KrakSend Contacts
description: A host-controlled KrakSend contact admin view with explicit email withdrawal, pagination, and no account-management dependency.
docs:
## Usage

Mount `SendContacts` only behind the host application's admin guard. Pass an authorized `page`, loading/error state, localized `messages`, `defaultContactLocale`, and `onCreate`/`onWithdraw` callbacks backed by the protected KrakSend API. Supply `onNext` and `onPrevious` for server pagination. Creating a contact does not subscribe it. There is deliberately no bulk subscribe action. Source-copy consumers import from `@/services/send/client/contacts`; package consumers import from `@krak-stack/registry/send/contacts`. The backend is an initial foundation, not a complete campaign platform. See `packages/send/README.md` for runtime policy, release ordering, and host authorization requirements.
